name: model-router
description: Routes each turn to the cheapest model + effort that fits the task (Haiku 5.5 → Sonnet 5.5 → Opus 5.5 → Fable 5.1) and shows the ladder in a side pane.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: haiku: a ~1s Haiku 5.5 call grades each prompt (heuristics as fallback). heuristic: keyword/shape scoring only, zero cost.

classifierModel.title: Classifier model
classifierModel.description: The model that grades each prompt when Classifier is haiku. Haiku 5.5 is the cheapest and fastest; Sonnet 5.5 grades more carefully for about 20x the cost. A blank value uses Haiku.

floor.title: Starting floor
floor.description: The cheapest model a new turn may start on, at low effort. Haiku (the default) means no floor: the router can start on Haiku. Sonnet means every turn starts on Sonnet or higher, while the router can still pick more or less effort within it. The highest model allowed still caps it.

ceiling.title: Highest model allowed
ceiling.description: Cost cap: the router never picks a model above this one.

band.title: Ladder band above the prompt
band.description: auto: a one-line ladder above the prompt where side panes aren't drawn (the desktop app). always: on every surface. never: side pane only.

stickiness.title: Downgrade stickiness (rungs)
stickiness.description: Default 3. How many dots lower a new pick must be before the router steps down while the prompt cache is warm (under 5 minutes since the last turn). 3 means it steps down only for a pick 3+ dots lower; 1 means it follows any drop; 0 turns the hold off. Upgrades always apply right away. A blank value uses the default.
